decision.name: SAME_CLOCK_CROSS_FILE_COHERENCE_NOT_PROVEN_BY_TIMESTAMP
decision.finding: Source review confirms run_once publishes latest.json, audit_latest.json, anata_latest.json with three separate atomic_write_json calls; each has as_of_ms but no shared immutable generation_id/manifest pointer. Two runs can share the same as_of_ms yet carry different evidence, so equality of the three timestamps alone cannot prove a coherent snapshot for readers. The pinned distinct-clock writer-B oracle is still necessary for its narrow two-writer test but is NOT sufficient to certify reader consistency or a same-clock collision. This is an integration acceptance-scope correction, not a new executed defect proof.
decision.acceptance: Do not promote on as_of_ms equality alone. In an authorized exact-SHA test checkout, run unchanged full baseline, materialize/hash corrected pinned P0 and separate P1 overlays, run targeted and full Capital Flow pytest. For any reader-based alternative, require a versioned manifest/generation token or equivalent verified coherent read protocol; exercise equal-as_of_ms writers with distinct evidence and an interleaved reader and reject mixed payloads. No new overlay/test or code was constructed or executed here.
